questions.text: How should the check handle missing, invalid, or out-of-range household size or income, including when SNAP is checked?
questions.rationale: The page asks for household size and monthly income (L7), but the rules only define income limits by household size and a SNAP override (L10-L12); no validation or SNAP handling of missing inputs is given.

options.label: Leave unspecified
options.detail: Extract only the stated eligibility behavior and leave validation and missing-field handling unresolved.

options.label: Require valid inputs
options.detail: Require positive whole-number household size and nonnegative monthly income even when SNAP is checked; show a validation error otherwise.

options.label: SNAP bypasses income
options.detail: Require valid household size, but SNAP households may omit income; otherwise require nonnegative income and show errors on invalid input.

questions.text: When SNAP qualifies a household regardless of income, which monthly limit should the result display?
questions.rationale: L12 grants eligibility regardless of income, while L13 requires the result to state the monthly limit applied; the relationship of that wording to the SNAP path is unclear.

options.label: Size limit shown
options.detail: Display the monthly limit for the household size alongside the eligible SNAP result, without using the limit to decide eligibility.

options.label: Not applicable
options.detail: Display that no income limit was applied for a SNAP-qualified household.

options.label: Leave unspecified
options.detail: Do not define the SNAP-path monthly-limit presentation until a source clarifies it.
